pages.title: Wearable Charms
pages.text: Talisman papers do nothing in your pack. Right-click a paper to fold it, then equip the folded talisman in a charm curio slot to activate its power.

A folded talisman remembers its paper type and its remaining uses, shown as a durability bar. A fully-charged folded talisman can be right-clicked to unfold it back into paper.$(br2)Each paper only triggers under its own condition, and each trigger spends uses with a short cooldown.
